streaming_strategy.fit: rolling posterior: keep recent max_run run-lengths (fix1c).
streaming_strategy.predict: one-step posterior update per new point.

inv.purpose: Bayesian online change-point detection with Student-t predictive likelihood (Adams & MacKay 2007). Run-length posterior plus NIG conjugate prior; score = P(change at t) = R[0], threshold 0.5. Student-t critical for heavy-tailed industrial data (SKAB: 32 percent DR at 13 percent FAR vs BOCPD-Gaussian ~0 percent DR).
